items: Asia has become a major center of AI innovation, driven by national strategies, tax incentives, research grants and strong venture capital investment in startups.
Businesses in the region can now use affordable cloud AI platforms, local developers and data scientists, and government innovation grants and sandbox programs.
To stay ahead, keep track of each country's AI and data rules, understand gaps in local infrastructure, and adapt AI models to local languages and context.
Start by auditing your own AI readiness across your tech stack, compliance and team skills, then explore regional pilot programs and local partnerships.
